title: Peanut Butter Tofu with Black Rice and Roasted Sweet Potato
subtitle: a festive vegan main
description: Crispy tofu slices coated in a rich peanut butter sauce, served over black rice cooked in coconut milk with roasted sweet potato and snow peas.

steps.text: Cook the rice: grate the ginger, wrap it in a piece of muslin and squeeze well. Keep the liquid and discard the pulp.

Put the rice in a pot with the ginger liquid, 2 cups water, the coconut milk and the salt and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover and cook for 40 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender but not falling apart.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and line 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Halve the sweet potatoes lengthways, put them in a bowl with the olive oil, 1 tbsp maple syrup, chilli flakes and sea salt and toss. Arrange on a tray.
Roast for 30 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and browned. Remove the tray and leave the oven on.

Make the sauce: blend all the sauce ingredients (the peanut butter, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, 2 tbsp maple syrup, crushed garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1/4 cup water) in a food processor until smooth.
Slice the tofu 2 cm thick and put in a bowl with the peanut butter sauce. Gently toss and transfer to a tray. Roast for 20 minutes until the tofu has a crisp coating. Blanch the snow peas.
Serve the rice on plates, top with a slice of tofu and drizzle with sauce. Serve with the sweet potato and snow peas.
